• Fixed (iOS): Auto Sync now offers Apple’s online English speech recognition when offline recognition is unavailable on an iPad, instead of rejecting the device.
• Privacy: Movie audio is sent to Apple only after you tap Allow; every attempt requires fresh consent. No microphone capture.
• Supported: iOS 15+, external English subtitles, readable MP4/HLS/local audio. Internet and Speech permission needed for online fallback; some streams remain unsupported.
